defensives.name: Aspect of the Turtle
defensives.usage_rule: Full immunity plus 30% damage reduction for 8 sec, but you cannot attack, so save it for a lethal hit you cannot otherwise survive.

defensives.name: Survival of the Fittest
defensives.usage_rule: 30% damage reduction for you and your pet on a short 6 sec window, so press it into a known raid hit rather than reactively.

defensives.name: Exhilaration
defensives.usage_rule: Instant heal for 30% of your health and a full heal for your pet; use it once you are actually low so none of it overheals.

defensives.name: Roar of Sacrifice
defensives.usage_rule: Cuts 15% of the damage taken by you or an ally for 10 sec at your pet's expense, so keep it for a targeted hit and not for sustained pet-killing damage.
